eval: JSON.stringify({strip: !!document.querySelector('.cmp-cfg-strip'), cards: document.querySelectorAll('.cmp-cfg-card').length, puzzle: [...document.querySelectorAll('.cmp-puzzle-panel .cmp-h')].map(h=>h.textContent.trim()), promptPanel: !!document.querySelector('.cmp-prompt-panel'), oldBottom: !!document.querySelector('.cmp-bottom'), oldCols: !!document.querySelector('.cmp-cols')})
const sel=document.querySelector('#cmp-edit-body select[data-f=scene_id]'); JSON.stringify({sceneOpts: sel? sel.options.length:-1, hasThumbHost: !!document.getElementById('cmp-scene-thumb')})

const sel=document.querySelector('#cmp-edit-body select[data-f=scene_id]'); let idx=-1; for(let i=0;i<sel.options.length;i++){ if(sel.options[i].value && i!==sel.selectedIndex){idx=i;break;} } if(idx>=0){ sel.selectedIndex=idx; sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); 'scene-set:'+sel.options[idx].text; } else 'no-other-scene'

const a=document.querySelector('#cmp-edit-body select[data-cf=appearance_id]'); if(!a){'no-appearance'} else { const cur=a.value; let idx=0; for(let i=0;i<a.options.length;i++){ if(a.options[i].value && a.options[i].value!==cur){idx=i;break;} } a.selectedIndex=idx; a.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); 'appearance -> '+a.options[idx].text; }

const g=document.querySelector('.cmp-shot'); if(!g){'no-gallery'} else { const r=g.getBoundingClientRect(); g.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('contextmenu',{bubbles:true,clientX:r.left+10,clientY:r.top+10})); 'ctx'; }
